name: With ?planner=1: New route without a key opens the key dialog; Cancel leaves everything as it was
eval: window.__P = { wait: (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)), click: (lat, lng) => { const ll = L.latLng(lat, lng); map.fire('click', { latlng: ll, containerPoint: map.latLngToContainerPoint(ll) }); }, card: () => document.getElementById('plan-card')?.textContent || '', stats: () => document.querySelector('.plan-stats')?.textContent, status: () => document.querySelector('.plan-status')?.textContent || '' }; PLAN_GAP_MS = 0; PLAN_LIMIT_WAIT_MS = 50; const hidden = document.getElementById('btn-new').hidden; document.getElementById('btn-new').click(); await __P.wait(50); const open = keyDialog.open; document.getElementById('key-cancel').click(); await __P.wait(50); return { hidden, open, plan: !!plan, key: ghKey() }

name: Saving the key starts planning: panel, profile, Undo disabled
eval: document.getElementById('btn-new').click(); await __P.wait(50); document.getElementById('key-input').value = '  test-key  '; document.getElementById('key-form').requestSubmit(); await __P.wait(50); return { plan: !!plan, key: ghKey(), title: document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent, foot: document.querySelector('[data-profile=foot]').classList.contains('primary'), undo: document.getElementById('btn-undo').disabled, start: __P.card().includes('Click the map to place the start'), credit: __P.card().includes('GraphHopper API') }

name: First click places the start without any request
eval: __P.click(48.96, 17.21); await __P.wait(50); return { pts: plan.pts.length, requests: __gh.requests.length, undo: document.getElementById('btn-undo').disabled, count: document.getElementById('wpt-count').textContent }

name: Second click finds the route: one request with the key and profile, distance and climb in the panel, line on the map
eval: __P.click(48.97, 17.22); await __P.wait(100); const r = __gh.requests[0]; const lines = []; planLayer.eachLayer(l => { if (l instanceof L.Polyline && !(l instanceof L.CircleMarker)) lines.push(l.getLatLngs().length); }); return { requests: __gh.requests.length, points: r.points.length, profile: r.profile, key: r.key, stats: __P.stats(), count: document.getElementById('wpt-count').textContent, state: plan.segs[0].state, pts: plan.segs[0].pts.length, lines, cursor: mapCursorMode(L.point(10, 10)) }

name: Points clicked while a request runs go together into the next one (max. 5 points), the rest into another
eval: __gh.requests.length = 0; __gh.mode = 'hold'; __P.click(48.98, 17.23); await __P.wait(30); const status = __P.status(); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) __P.click(48.99 + i / 100, 17.24 + i / 100); __gh.mode = 'ok'; __gh.release(); await __P.wait(150); return { status, sizes: __gh.requests.map(r => r.points.length), allOk: plan.segs.every(s => s.state === 'ok'), segs: plan.segs.length, stats: __P.stats(), done: __P.status() }

name: A leg with a split answer keeps its own line: request 2 is cut into 4 segments
eval: return { lens: plan.segs.map(s => s.pts.length), ends: plan.segs[1].pts[3].lat === plan.segs[2].pts[0].lat }

name: Undo removes the last point and its segment; Redo stays disabled
eval: document.getElementById('btn-undo').click(); await __P.wait(30); return { pts: plan.pts.length, segs: plan.segs.length, stats: __P.stats(), redo: document.getElementById('btn-redo').disabled }

name: Undo during a running request: the late answer changes nothing
eval: __gh.mode = 'hold'; __P.click(49.1, 17.3); await __P.wait(30); undo(); await __P.wait(30); __gh.mode = 'ok'; __gh.release(); await __P.wait(80); return { pts: plan.pts.length, segs: plan.segs.length, stats: __P.stats(), status: __P.status() }

name: Per-minute limit (429): waits with a message and continues by itself, no error
eval: __gh.requests.length = 0; __gh.seq = ['limit', 'limit']; __P.click(49.1, 17.3); await __P.wait(20); const status = __P.status(); await __P.wait(200); return { status: status.includes('per-minute limit'), requests: __gh.requests.length, state: plan.segs.at(-1).state, error: plan.error, after: __P.status() }

name: Per-minute limit that does not end: after the last attempt an error with Try again
eval: PLAN_LIMIT_TRIES = 3; __gh.mode = 'limit'; __P.click(49.11, 17.31); await __P.wait(200); const r = { state: plan.segs.at(-1).state, error: plan.error.startsWith('GraphHopper limit reached'), retry: !!document.getElementById('plan-retry') }; __gh.mode = 'ok'; PLAN_LIMIT_TRIES = 8; document.getElementById('plan-retry').click(); await __P.wait(80); return { ...r, after: plan.segs.at(-1).state, gone: !document.getElementById('plan-retry') }

name: Daily limit (429 without 'minute'): error at once, no automatic retry
eval: __gh.requests.length = 0; __gh.mode = 'daily'; __P.click(49.12, 17.32); await __P.wait(100); const r = { n: __gh.requests.length, state: plan.segs.at(-1).state, msg: plan.error.includes('Daily API credit limit') }; __gh.mode = 'ok'; document.getElementById('plan-retry').click(); await __P.wait(80); return { ...r, after: plan.segs.at(-1).state }

name: No route to a point (400): error, other points wait; Undo removes it and the rest continues
eval: __gh.seq = ['http400']; __P.click(43.0, 5.5); await __P.wait(50); const r = { error: plan.error, retry: !!document.getElementById('plan-retry') }; const n = plan.pts.length; undo(); await __P.wait(80); return { ...r, removed: n - plan.pts.length, allOk: plan.segs.every(s => s.state === 'ok'), cleared: plan.error }

expect.error: No route to this point. Use Undo and click somewhere else.
